Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry. You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work ® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow. Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA. About The Role & Team SITA has deployed a full Datalink Service Provider solution based on a combination of commercial of the shelf (COTS) and proprietary applications from the ground up on behalf of a Japanese customer encompassing central infrastructure, applications at customer premises and more than 250 radios deployed at 60 airports in Japan. You will work in Tokyo at the customer premises and SITA will train the incumbent on the infrastructure and applications deployed in Japan. You will provide expert technical support and life cycle management of the central Datalink service infrastructure and applications (platforms, network, and application components such as core traffic processor, monitoring, back-office as well as VHF stations and radios) at customer’s premises and in Japanese airports What You Will Do During the implementation project Participate in the implementation of a multi-year project to deliver the SITA solution to the Japanese customer. Ensures the integration and operational implementation of the Datalink applications in the target customer environment. Participate in migration activities from the legacy system to the new solution. As an On-going solution expert technical support, on a roster basis: You have to ensure office hours presence at customer’s operation office in Tokyo including weekends, to provide continuous support to the service. Provide 24x7 on-call support. Provide Service Operations support to internal and external customers in accordance with the terms of the customer contract and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Manage incidents and problems and participate in root cause analysis. Ensure the correct functioning and maintenance of all internal and external systems. Carry out preventive and proactive maintenance of equipment and monitoring of systems and services in accordance with agreed schedules and customer expectations. Perform Change Management, Configurations, Design and Implementation. Manage local suppliers and report on services provided. Conducts the analysis, definition, documentation and testing of application & systems enhancements. Coordinate with the customer and the SITA development team, the operational changes, application upgrades, including integration tests, migrations, and operational deployments. Provide onsite support to users during the cutover of the services. Continuously identify and document lessons learnt, known errors and operational knowledge for improved services. Continuously monitor and analyse the Datalink service performance using the SITA dedicated traffic log, monitoring, back-office statistics, and configuration tools. Prepare performance reports (platforms, applications, and datalink service). Coordinate with the third-party vendors (DELL, CISCO etc.) the pro-active implementation of vendor provided updates. Participate in customer meetings as a SITA representative and communicate clearly in both Japanese and English with the Customer and SITA teams in Japan, Europe, and Canada. Qualifications ABOUT YOUR SKILLS: 5 to10 years’ experience in implementation or support of complex applications, with experience in multiple full lifecycle implementations. Technical knowledge or understanding on: oInfrastructure & networks (Wide Area Networks, LAN, DELL, CISCO, VMWare) oOperating systems (Windows, Linux) oMiddleware (IBM WebSphere MQ, Oracle DB, MS SQL) oVHF & Radio knowledge Excellent fluency in written and spoken English and Japanese, with strong documentation and communication skills in both languages to effectively convey information between Japanese customers and SITA global teams. Ability to work in a multi-cultural environment and a global team (Japan, Europe, North America). Knowledge of Aviation Datalink Communication Standards is a plus. Able to travel (limited travel inside Japan, Canada, Singapore and Europe). University degree or equivalent preferably in Computer Science Engineering Mathematics or similar. Where applicable a recognised professional qualification is desirable (e.g., CISCO certification). What We Offer We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever. 🏡 Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs) ⏰ Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans. 🌎 Flex-Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world. 🌿 Employee Wellbeing: We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs. 🚀 Professional Development: At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative, and Airport Council International -available to all employees-to specialized solutions like Pluralsight for technology upskilling, Harvard Business Publishing for people leadership, Stanford for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way. 🙌 Competitive Benefits: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status. SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process. These environments support the Firm’s applications and are key to the Firm’s security, disaster recovery and business continuity initiatives. Must have a detailed technical knowledge of infrastructure products with experience in security configuration. Experience must include understanding performance, security and application requirements and ability to design appropriate solutions. In depth knowledge of Microsoft Azure Active Directory, DNS, WINs, DHCP, network topologies, along with expert knowledge in performance tuning and troubleshooting. Experience with Unified Communications and Collaboration technologies. Must have senior technical skills in order to provide interpretation and communication/negotiation between technical resources to ensure that requirements are gathered and defined precisely and to plan for effective and timely implementation. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment. Strong communication and interpersonal skills required to work with staff of all levels on a daily basis. Minimum Education High School or GED Preferred Education Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field Minimum Years Of Experience 5 years' experience with Active Directory, computer storage and networking. Essential Job Expectations All DLA Piper employees are expected to demonstrate excellence in how we serve our clients and develop our people, upholding our firm values as part of our culture. review_candidates.title: Cloud Operations Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description At Verint, we believe customer engagement is the core of every global brand. Our mission is to help organizations elevate Customer Experience (CX) and increase workforce productivity by delivering CX Automation. We hire innovators with the passion, creativity, and drive to answer constantly shifting market challenges and deliver impactful results for our customers. Our commitment to attracting and retaining a talented, diverse, and engaged team creates a collaborative environment that openly celebrates all cultures and affords personal and professional growth opportunities. Learn more at www.verint.com . Overview of Job Function: We are looking for a highly skilled Cloud Operations Engineer to join our Cloud Operations team. This role supports the management of the Cloud Infrastructure that facilitates our applications across the breadth of the Verint product portfolio, and provides the assurance needed to troubleshoot, maintain, provision and ensure availability of the underlying platforms. The ideal candidate is passionate about systems administration, knowledgeable across providing support to internal and external clients, and excited to contribute to a culture of modern technology, security, documentation, reliability, and continuous improvement. As part of a distributed global team, this role also helps provide 24/7 operational coverage for critical environments. Principal Duties and Essential Responsibilities: Support and maintain production environment infrastructure across the entire Verint Portfolio of products in the Cloud and their underlying platforms. Troubleshoot and resolve various incidents that arise with regards to Cloud Infrastructure. Upgrade and modify infrastructure as needed to support client and business needs. Delivery & Collaboration Provision new environments and infrastructure that support the Verint product portfolio. Collaborate closely with Support, Engineering, and Professional Services in the delivery of both internal initiatives and client facing projects. Work with technologies such as: JIRA/Confluence ServiceNow Windows and Linux EC2 Instances AWS, Azure, and GCP Platforms Deployment Pipelines and Tools SQL Server Documentation & Knowledge Management Develop and maintain internal knowledge bases to reduce tribal knowledge and improve team scalability. Participate in cross-team knowledge transfer sessions, documentation efforts, and process standardization.
